_doc: Chatbot agent knowledge base (editable from /admin → Knowledge tab). Every entry is injected into the chatbot + Telegram bot system prompt so the assistant can answer questions about THIS site with real facts. Markdown allowed in answers.

entries.answer: **AI Gateway API** is a production-ready REST gateway for AI providers. Send **one** `POST /api/v1/chat` request and it routes to OpenRouter, OpenCode Zen, Poolside AI or any OpenAI-compatible provider. If a provider errors, the gateway **automatically fails over** to the next one until a response arrives. Provider API keys live only in server env vars — they are never exposed to browsers.

entries.topic: How to call the chat endpoint (POST)
entries.answer:
```bash
curl https://aigatewaybd.pages.dev/api/v1/chat \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"message": "Hello!"}'
```
Optional body fields: `provider`, `model`, `system_prompt`, `temperature` (0–2), `max_tokens`, `failover` (false pins one provider). You can also send multi-turn `{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"..."}]}`.

entries.topic: GET shortcut — open the API from a browser link
entries.answer:
Two GET-style endpoints work directly in the browser — no headers, no body:

1. `GET /api/v1/chat?prompt=...` — full endpoint.
2. `GET /ask?prompt=...` — short custom shortcut.

Example: [https://aigatewaybd.pages.dev/ask?prompt=Say%20hi%20in%20Bangla](/ask?prompt=Say%20hi%20in%20Bangla) returns JSON instantly. Add `&raw=1` for plain text, `&provider=poolside` to pin a provider.

Failover is ON by default and works at the MODEL level: if a model errors (rate limit, timeout, outage, bad response), the gateway tries EVERY other model of the same provider one by one (up to FAILOVER_MODELS_MAX, default 6, newest-failed models skipped for 5 min); if the whole provider fails, it instantly moves to the NEXT provider and walks all of its models too — cycling up to FAILOVER_MAX_ROUNDS rounds (default 3) with a hard cap of FAILOVER_MAX_ATTEMPTS upstream calls (default 12) until a response arrives. The response reports `provider`, `model` and the full attempt log under `failover`. Set `"failover": false` to pin a single provider and its primary model.

GET `/api/v1/models` auto-fetches every provider's live catalog. **OpenRouter** and **OpenCode Zen** list only their FREE models (`:free` / `-free` ids); other providers list the full catalog. Results are cached (default 6 h); `?refresh=1` forces a re-fetch. The admin can also pin curated models per provider from the Admin Panel.

- **JavaScript/Python/cURL**: copy ready examples from the Guide page (/guide/).
- **Telegram bot**: full functional webhook + polling code on the Telegram page (/telegram/).
- **Any app**: call the GET shortcut `/ask?prompt=...` — pure URL integration.

Deployed on **Cloudflare Pages** from GitHub (build: `npm run build`, output: `out`). All configuration lives in environment variables — the complete importable file with step-by-step instructions is on the **Env Setup** page (/env-setup/).

The owner-only Admin Panel (/admin/) signs in with a GitHub token and provides **full CRUD**: add/edit/delete AI Providers and their models, edit the chatbot knowledge base, site branding, announcement banner and chatbot settings. Every save commits to the GitHub repo → Cloudflare Pages redeploys automatically.
